description: A simple todo list in the VS Code sidebar
config.defaultStoragePath.description: Default path to the storage file for all workspaces (relative to workspace root, e.g. `.vscode/toudou-{workspace}.json`). Use `{workspace}` as a placeholder for the workspace name. Can be overridden per workspace with [Set Workspace Storage Path](command:toudou.setWorkspacePath).
config.defaultAddMode.description: Controls which command the `+` button in the Toudou view uses by default.
config.defaultAddMode.quick.description: Quick add: only asks for a title.
config.defaultAddMode.complete.descripti: Complete add: asks for title, category and description.
config.watchExternalChanges.description: Reload the storage file when it is modified outside this window (Obsidian plugin, another VS Code window, another machine through a synced folder). Disable only if the file is never shared.
config.watchIntervalSeconds.description: How often the storage file is checked for external changes, in seconds. Lower reacts faster, higher is gentler on synced folders.
